episodes.title: Get Your Nonna a Necklace
episodes.summary: Tasked with buying a sentimental gift for their dying grandmother, bickering siblings Nicky and Morgan commit a minor crime with major consequences.

episodes.title: I Will Do ANYTHING to Survive
episodes.summary: A dangerous ultimatum from Yusuf forces Morgan and Nicky to run interference at an already chaotic family funeral.

episodes.title: Show Me The Money
episodes.summary: Nicky and Morgan's success is short-lived when they're coerced into a "friendship" with Yusuf's boss. Linda reconsiders her run for mayor.

episodes.title: Weakness Always Exposes Itself
episodes.summary: Nicky and Tareq share their feelings, while Morgan and Max get personal at couple's therapy. A surprise guest adds extra spice to a family dinner.

episodes.title: James 4:17
episodes.summary: When a job at a cattle auction goes sideways, Nicky must leverage his job to prove his worth. Linda's campaign gets a boost from a political scandal.

episodes.title: You F-ck With My Family, You F-ck with Me
episodes.summary: A fed-up Nicky tries to cut ties with Ivan — and his sister — as he prepares to come clean about Tareq. Morgan attends an uncomfortable baby shower.

episodes.title: I've Really Enjoyed My Time with You
episodes.summary: Anxious to impress an important partner, Ivan splashes out on a trip to Miami. Nicky and Morgan connect on a new level after a stimulating dinner.

episodes.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
episodes.summary: Morgan and Nicky brace for blowback from the Miami operation as their family, friends and some unwelcome faces converge around the election results.
